title: Watch folders
intro: New files that appear in a watched folder are converted automatically with the preset you choose. Results go to a “converted” folder inside it.

empty.title: Convert files as they arrive
empty.message: Pick a folder and a preset. Every new file in that folder is processed once it has finished copying; files already there are left alone and results are saved in its “converted” subfolder.

noPresets: No preset can run on its own. Make one on the Presets page.

errors.presetMissing: This preset no longer exists. Choose another one.
errors.presetNotUnattended: This preset needs a folder choice or the editor, so it can't run on its own. Choose another one.
errors.missingTool: Needs a tool that isn't installed yet. Install it from Engines.
